## COORD — Coordinating work

→ [standard](standards-coordination.md)

The coordinator binding a repository shows, and the responsiveness, reporting and currency of the coordinators who work there.

- **COORD-8 [M] — the coordinator hook and output style are bound where ki-coordination is declared** — In the runtime-specific Claude Code binding, a repository that declares `[skills.ki-coordination]` selects `"outputStyle": "ki-coordinator"` in its tracked `.claude/settings.json`, and, where the user's Claude Code settings are present, they run the harness `hooks/coordinator-reminder/coordinator-reminder.sh` at `UserPromptSubmit` and `SessionStart` and the style is deployed as `~/.claude/output-styles/ki-coordinator.md`. The user-environment manager, chezmoi, stays the binder; the rubric only checks that the binding is present. (standards-coordination.md#coordinator-responsiveness)
  - _Remediation:_ diagnostic — Select the output style in the repository's tracked `.claude/settings.json`; bind the hook and deploy the style through the user-environment manager, such as `chezmoi apply` after reviewing `chezmoi diff`, rather than by editing user settings by hand.
- **COORD-4 [J] — coordinators stay responsive and work stays current** — A coordinator never does substantive work itself, sends every unit of work to a detached background agent and treats an owner message as steering rather than a stop; each turn makes at most five tool calls with reads limited to the work package, one read of its files counting as one call, the agent host view of its agents, one report and one short file and writes limited to the work package, its change documents included, and a brief, waits only on the agent host notice or a detached background check, keeps a background check armed while work lies with a worker that wakes it only when a run finishes, with no timed bound and no timed update while it waits, with no heartbeat otherwise, keeps one inbox watcher armed only when the owner has asked the thread to listen, or it is a Rig host sync thread, and the work is not draining, On hold or Finished, that silently fetches and fast-forwards and wakes it only on a new message line or a finished run, shows the listening line in the banner only while the session is in a meeting, naming the meetings, acts on new `messages.md` lines at each wake in queue order, important lines first, answers owner messages within one short turn and reports drift in one line; each territory Capital has one main State of play coordinating registered Project packages within its cap, through explicit committed assignment and acknowledged handover of in-flight runs without timeout takeover; the assignment field remains undecided. It acts in one assigned package per turn, keeps the queue and seeds each package and opener, and any secondary State of play names the main as `parent`, the tree beneath it being its register, and routes cross-cutting matters to the main, which stays the front door for the owner; Project work works only its Project, follows the bootstrap, keeps the state in its `_index.md` current and records approvals before launching; a routed line is never rejected whole, only the part not its own returned once to the State of play that routed it. (standards-coordination.md#coordinator-responsiveness, standards-listening.md#inbox-watch, standards-territory.md#coordinating-work)
  - _Evidence scope:_ Coordinator transcripts, work packages, change documents and summaries the owner selects for review.
  - _Review prompt:_ Did the coordinator keep within five tool calls a turn, delegate rather than analyse, draft, edit, test or wait in the foreground, issue no command that may wait for a permission prompt, such as an `rm` with a glob, variable or `$(...)` target, `git worktree remove` or a foreground `sleep` of 60 seconds or more, give timed updates only when work launched or a run finished, with no timed wake or update while waiting, keep the inbox watcher armed only when the owner had asked the thread to listen, or it was a Rig host sync thread, and the work was not draining, On hold or Finished, show a listening line in the banner only while in a meeting, naming the meetings, answer owner messages within one short turn and stop work only on an express, named instruction, does territory work stay on project management with active Project work within the cap and a prepared package and opener for each, and does each piece of Project work run through background agents from a current state in its `_index.md`, taking its message queue in priority order?
  - _Outcomes:_ conforming; delegate longer work; escalate to owner
  - _Conforming guidance:_ Move longer coordinator work into background agents and note the drift in the Now of `_index.md`; escalate to territory work when a direction touches more than one Project.
- **COORD-5 [J] — coordinators park tangents, link records and keep checkouts current** — A coordinator parks each passing side topic as a new change document for its area, numbered after the others, holding its dated line, cites and links every record, work file, theme and Project by full identifier and local path, and fast-forward pulls affected clean primary checkouts after background agents push. Commit each complete unit and finished package change by explicit path before its turn ends; sync after each finished change and at least every 15 minutes. Push everything stacked on main, including other sessions' commits, fast-forward only, never forced or with --no-verify, stopping on divergence. Conflict repair belongs to a bounded isolated run that rebases only this work's unpublished commits and stops on other content, uncertain ownership or judgement. High-confidence or reversible work lands on main without waiting for the owner, a pull request only where something major is at stake and destructive work only on the owner's word, and the session that did the work writes its record as it lands, one for each unattended run or batch that lands real work and none for a session spent deciding. (standards-mark.md#parking-tangents, standards-reporting.md#linking-records, standards-sync.md#keeping-primary-checkouts-current, standards-sync.md#landing-then-review)
  - _Evidence scope:_ Coordinator transcripts, status lines, reports, summaries and work files the owner selects for review.
  - _Review prompt:_ Were side topics parked without derailing the work and later homed or dropped, does every mention of a record, work file, theme or Project carry its full identifier and a local link, and are the owner's primary checkouts current, with dirty or diverged ones reported rather than altered? Were completed package changes committed promptly, was the 15-minute sync floor met, and did any conflict run stay within those ownership and authority boundaries?
  - _Outcomes:_ conforming; park or home tangents; fix references; refresh checkouts; escalate to owner
  - _Conforming guidance:_ Move tangents into a new change document for their area or their proper home, replace short or unlinked references with full identifiers and local paths, and fast-forward only clean checkouts; report a dirty or diverged checkout to the owner instead of repairing it.

- **COORD-13 [J] — coordinators have doubtful and destructive queries reviewed blind** — Before a query reaches the owner, a coordinator sends every query whose recommended option carries `medium` or `low` confidence, and every `high` one whose course destroys, deletes or publishes, to one blind review run on the strongest model at high effort, under Codex rather than Claude Code where independence matters; agreement lifts the confidence one level, never to `high` for a destructive course resting on claims not verified directly, with its reason beginning `reviewed`, and disagreement keeps the confidence, begins the reason `review disagrees` and shows both views in the query. The review brief carries the review-independence sentence and states earlier decisions as dated facts, and a review that challenges an earlier decision is shown at the end of the Context with an option to revisit it, never acted on without the owner. The queries a run report raises are reviewed at receive. A query still below high confidence after review is split into separately tagged parts; packed queries are unpacked before an unattended window. After a Summary that lists open queries, and on request, the interactive pass asks exactly one decision at a time, each query in two replies, and logs and reads back each answer before the next, saying what was chosen and what it changes; every query also offers Talk it through now and Come back at the end, and the queries deferred to the end are taken again before the closing mark. (standards-queries.md#query-review, standards-queries.md#interactive-pass)
  - _Evidence scope:_ Coordinator summaries, change documents and review-run reports the owner selects for review.
  - _Review prompt:_ Did every medium- or low-confidence query, and every high-confidence query with a destructive course, pass one blind review run before it reached the owner, did the run see the query without its recommendation or confidence, with the review-independence sentence and earlier decisions stated as dated facts, does each agreed query show its lifted confidence with a reason beginning `reviewed`, or, where the agreement rests only on precedent or only on how the coordinator framed it, its unchanged confidence with a reason beginning `reviewed, precedent only`, does each disputed one keep its confidence and show both views, and does each challenge to an earlier decision end the Context with an option to revisit it?
  - _Outcomes:_ conforming; review the query; show both views; escalate to owner
  - _Conforming guidance:_ Hold an unreviewed query back from the owner until one blind review run has seen it, then mark it reviewed with its lifted confidence, or with its unchanged confidence and `reviewed, precedent only` where the agreement rests only on precedent or framing, or show both views, and show any challenge at the end of the Context with an option to revisit it; never raise a destructive course resting on claims not verified directly to high.
